item.title: Change of address
item.description: Archive Magazine has moved! The new address is Archive Magazine, Beresford Business Centre, 2 Beresford Road, Coleraine, BT52 1GE, United Kingdom. All other contact details remain the same. Items sent to the previous address should still be delivered.

item.title: Taking a couple of weeks off
item.description: I had hoped to get the July/August issue out in July, which would have got the magazine back into a nice rhythm with the calendar months (i.e. issue 1 out Jan/Feb, issue 6 out Nov/Dec). Unfortunately, at the end of March, my mother passed away, and last week, my father. Two wonderful parents. I'm going to take a week or two for some time with my family, and I'll make sure that the July/August issue will be with you in August - I am very grateful for the contributions to this issue, it'll be anot

item.title: Back to work
item.description: I'm back in the office today after taking a little time away due to recent bereavements. Production has now resumed on the upcoming issue (Archive 26:4). The plan remains to get the new issue to you this month (August). I've also a pretty big backlog of emails that I'm now trying to get through, so please bear with me. If you haven't had a reply by Monday 14th August, please feel free to re-send in case I have missed it.

item.title: September update
item.description: I had hoped to get the new issue of Archive with you by the end of August, but alas, it's not quite there yet. The material is all in place, but it needs a little more editing time. It will still be dated the July/August issue, and it kicks off with a fantastic article about using the RISC OS Toolbox with Python, from none other than Chris Johns. Thanks for your patience after a tough six months. By the end of this year, we will be on a very regular schedule. You'll see!

item.title: Archive Magazine Volume 26 Issue 4 is out now!
item.description: Archive Magazine Volume 26 Issue 4 is out now!Welcome to a brand new 52 page issue of Archive Magazine. After a comprehensive news roundup, Chris Johns leads us in creating Toolbox apps with Python. (Incidentally, this is our fifth Python-related article in Archive in recent times). Next, we have an introduction to Partition Manager, followed by Hearsay, our interview column. In the hot seat for this issue is Andrew Rawnsley, with his gaming hat on. Find out how RISC OS got Doom, Quake and more!

item.title: Deadline for the next issue (Jan/Feb 2025)
item.description: The deadline for contributions to Archive 27:4 (Jan/Feb 2025) issue is 20th January 2025. Contributions can be accepted in any format, but RISC OS formats (Impression, Ovation Pro, TechWriter etc.) are preferred. Please send any contributions to gavin@archivemag.co.uk. Thanks for getting involved with Archive, the magazine for RISC OS users!

item.title: Blog Post
item.description: Coming soon… Archive Volume 27 Issue 6Archive 27:6 will be with subscribers by 17th October, after several false starts over the summer! It is another packed issue, and includes an exclusive Archive interview with Hermann Hauser, currently at Amadeus Capital, but will be best known to readers as the cofounder of Acorn Computers, along with Chris Curry. The new issue also includes the latest RISC OS news, plus tutorials, articles, hints&tips, 8-bit Acorn retro news, and much more. Subscribe now!

item.title: Still another issue to go this year!
item.description: Vol. 27 Issue 6 should have arrived with all subscribers last week, so attention now turns to the next issue. Arriving in time for some Xmas reading, Vol. 28 Issue 1 will be with subscribers around the 15th December. The deadline for content is a little earlier than usual, 15th December - this is to make sure the printers have plenty of time over the festive period. If you have any contributions (reviews, articles, hints and tips, news, letters/email), please do send them in to gavin@archivemag.
